features.name: supplied_log_length
features.definition: What is the supplied log-transformed length value for the discussion?
features.spec: df['log_length'] converted with pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce'); return the numeric value as-is (no re-derivation, no log base assumption); missing or non-numeric gives null.

h0: supplied_log_length has no association with the probability that the OP changes their view (delta).
h1: Higher supplied_log_length is associated with a higher probability that the OP changes their view (delta).
note: Uses the supplied log_length column as given; its construction, source text, log base and timing are undocumented, so it is not equated with argument word count and may include post-outcome text. The OLS is a linear probability model; the result is an association, not causal.
